desc: Parse the single integer N from standard input.

Implement the full solution via difference-parameter enumeration with closed-form quadratic (d while d^3 <= N, N%d==0, Delta=12Q-3d^2, isqrt perfect-square test, s>3d, (s-3d)%6==0, y=(s-3d)//6, x=y+d).
Verify y >= 1 and x^3 - y^3 == N before printing; output "x y" on first valid pair else -1.
Use exact integer arithmetic only (no float cube/sqrt roots) and re-check the d upper bound condition d^3 <= N.
Validate against the three samples (397 -> 12 11; 1 -> -1; 39977273855577088 -> 342756 66212) -- all passed.
